title: Foundations of Web Development
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Foundations of Web Development - Certificate of Achievement: Mesa
outcomes: Technological Awareness: Students will be able to evaluate and apply appropriate technology to support specific business activities and business solutions.

Critical Thinking: Students will be able to analyze specific business problems or situations and identify possible solutions, including predictive analysis, synthesis of information, resourcefulness, and troubleshooting.

Communication: Students will be able to choose the appropriate mode of communication for a specific situation and then communicate ideas, concepts, and solutions through effective written and oral communication.

missing_explained.why: not in the requirements; named only as an advisory in the WEBD 191 course description

notes: The catalog's requirement list (WEBD 152, 164, 168, 171, 172, 191) differs substantially from the state closed list; WEBD 172 and WEBD 191 are catalog additions and MULT 100, WEBD 166, WEBD 167, WEBD 173 do not appear in the requirements. The program may have been revised since the Program Course File was filed.

The learning outcomes are business-oriented (business activities, business solutions) and may be shared with a broader department/program outcomes set rather than written specifically for this certificate; recorded as printed under this award.
The description also refers to 'entry-level careers' generically; not recorded as a named career.
Course descriptions printed after the requirements contain no course-level outcomes.
